name: hubspot-mcp
description: Every HubSpot Sales Hub feature, plus offline cross-object queries, property-change-history reporting, and an agent-native data layer no other HubSpot tool has.

hubspot_access_token.title: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN
hubspot_access_token.description: Sets HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN for the HubSpot MCP server. Get a credential from https://app.hubspot.com/private-apps.

hubspot_base_url.title: HubSpot API base URL
hubspot_base_url.description: Base URL for the HubSpot API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

hubspot_owner_email.title: Default owner email
hubspot_owner_email.description: Email address that `--owner me` resolves to when git config user.email is not set. Leave blank to name the owner on each call.

hubspot_mcp_http_token.title: HTTP transport bearer token
hubspot_mcp_http_token.description: Bearer token that `hubspot-mcp --transport http` requires from every HTTP client (Authorization: Bearer). Leave blank for the default stdio transport, which Claude Desktop uses and which never reads it.

hubspot_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
hubspot_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on HubSpot requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
